shortDescription: Netherlands 10 Year Government Bond Yield increased to 3.49%, the highest since May 2011.Over the past 4 weeks, Netherlands 10Y Bond Yield gained 20.51 basis points, and in the last 12 months, it increased 65.51 basis points.
